lowerRotationControl.anchor: bottom midpoint of the presented vertical selection face
lowerRotationControl.glyphSpace: one complete symmetric fixed-size SVG mask rigidly rotated toward the active face anchor; the hover protractor, not the idle mask, is projected into the world workplane

upperRotationControls.anchor: top midpoint of the matching camera-facing selection face

axisToFace.worldX: camera-facing X face; glyph lies in world Y-Z
axisToFace.worldZ: camera-facing Z face; glyph lies in world X-Y

upperRotationControls.projection: one affine SVG transform per world rotation plane

moveControls.glyph: two opposing filled triangles with no connecting shaft
